arabic: قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ مَادِحاً صَاحِبَهُ لَا مَحَالَةَ فَلْيَقُلْ: أَحْسِبُ فُلَاناً وَاللهُ حَسِيبُهُ، وَلَا أُزَكِّي عَلَى اللهِ أَحَداً، أَحْسِبُهُ إِنْ كَانَ يَعْلَمُ ذَاكَ كَذَا وَكَذَا.
transliteration: Ahsibu fulaanan wallaahu haseebuhu, wa laa uzakkee 'alallaahi ahadan...
translation: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'If any of you must praise his companion, let him say: I consider so-and-so to be such and such, and Allah is his Reckoner, and I do not praise anyone above Allah (i.e. I do not purify anyone before Allah)... if he knows him to be such.'
